displayIdentity.body: Moses says the LORD will raise a prophet like him, explicitly connects the promise to Israel’s Horeb request not to hear the voice or see the fire, and gives a test about the prophet’s word.
displayIdentity.title: The requested mediator becomes a promise of a prophet
